AI is now a school subject in India.

The Ministry of Education announced AI and computational thinking for students from Class 3 starting 2026-27. NCERT has also released a 20 hour AI module for Classes 9 to 12 that covers deepfakes and data privacy.

Your juniors will learn this in school. Start now.

Sources: TechWire Asia (Nov 2025), PTI via Careers360 (Oct 2026).

Send this to a teacher or parent.
